en: Please come back later.
Welcome,
I'm glad we have time to talk.
If you could come during the day,
I'd have more time for you, though.
I look forward to our talk.
I came because I was told this is
Isaac's house...
That sounds like difficult work.
Wow... I'm learning a lot.
May I drop by now and then?
Yes.
I've become interested in philosophers,
so I hoped to hear you speak, Isaac...
Work? That's not quite it, I'd say.
May I drop by now and then?
How good of you to come.
It seems you're a bit of a rumor in town.
Still, some things do reach me.
Yes, that's right.
This is my first time in London.
London seems to be the most advanced city
in culture and civilization.
Well, so people generally say.
But people's minds have not matured.
They must look deeper into themselves.
But they're so driven by daily labor that
they have no time for that, as things are.
As you see, I rarely even go outside.
Nor do I care to find out...
Do tell me if you hear anything interesting.
I was told this is the home of Isaac the
philosopher. I'd like to hear you speak.
Indeed it is. I am Isaac.
If it's not urgent, please come tomorrow.
Welcome,
If you could come during the day, I'd have
more time for you, though.
I look forward to our talk.
Isaac...
Your ideas are wonderful.
But thinking alone doesn't solve anything.
I've already set out on my path, so
I can't stand still and contemplate.
So...
So, please help me, just for a little while.
Oh, my master... Your orders, please.
Sleepy... or rather, mornings are hard on me.
And I do get plenty of sleep.
, my master, for you
note: Servant mode, name first: '{NAME}, my master, for you / I would do anything.' Follows #0 ', my master...' wording (slice 000). Also Belinda msg 316057, then #8083.

en: I would do anything.
The sunlight is so bright...
I feel like I've turned into a mole or a bat.
Oh, and who might you be?
If it's the water bill, I've already paid it.
Do I look like a bill collector to you?
A pleasure to meet you, Felix.
Ah... just an ordinary visitor, then.
You know my name, I see.
Let me say it properly: how do you do.
I'm told that, as scientists go around here,
you are about the only one.
What sort of research do you do?
Well, er, that is...
It's hard to explain to a layman.
I also do some inventing, of sorts,
let's put it that way.
Hmm. Most interesting.
I shall call again.
Oh my, leaving so soon?
Until next time.
Sorry I took you for a reporter or such.
note: Felix took the player for a reporter in this branch (the water-bill line belongs to the first-visit branch); kept as in JP.

en: Er, your name was...
is the name, Felix.
I neglected to ask you last time, but...
Oh, back so soon?
Are you visiting again?
Do come in. Please don't touch the
test tubes.
I'm in the middle of a little experiment...
